entities.name: Handoff contingency planning
observations: Explicit recommendations for anticipated events and contingency actions are the best single listed safety intervention during physician handoff.
ED-specific I-PASS adaptation work supported retaining situation-awareness and contingency planning; evidence was qualitative and primarily addressed feasibility and suitability.
Receiver synthesis or read-back complements contingency planning but was not shown to be superior as a standalone intervention.
